events.name: Australia v South Africa
events.selectedSentence: Australia’s Argentina series win faces a sterner test against a Springbok side fresh from beating New Zealand 3–1.
events.fullSpiel: The 27 September Test at Optus Stadium puts the Mandela Plate on the line before Australia’s Bledisloe block. Jordan Petaia returns to the Wallabies squad for the first time since the 2023 World Cup, while Harry McLaughlin-Phillips replaces injured Carter Gordon in the group. Those selection options add interest to a Perth meeting between sides that shared two emphatic results in 2025. The squad announcement is not a confirmed match-day XV.

events.name: Port Adelaide v Adelaide Crows
events.selectedSentence: Port Adelaide enter 14th and Adelaide Crows 11th; a late-season test of where both clubs finish.
events.fullSpiel: Port Adelaide are 14th with 8 points, while Adelaide Crows are 11th with 12. That makes this more than a date in Round 8: it is a late-season test of where both clubs finish, with the next chapter shaped by the separation they create or erase.
